name: Publish Discord-approved posts to LinkedIn with edits and token alerts

parameters.content:
## Publish Discord-approved posts to LinkedIn with edits and token alerts

For teams using the companion drafting workflow who need approved drafts published to a LinkedIn company page, and nothing else.

### How it works
1. Every 5 minutes it reads the log. An open draft past its approval window is closed as expired, never published.
2. It reads the reply in Discord. Only a human's whole-message `post` or `cancel`, or `edit` with a new caption below it, counts.
3. An edit is checked against the same caption rules. If it passes, it is re-sent with the same image as a new draft that needs its own `post`. If not, the bot replies with the reasons.
4. On `post` it confirms the message is unchanged since delivery, then registers the image, uploads it and publishes. A rejected token posts one alert and keeps the approval open.
5. The post URN goes into the log and the bank row is marked posted.
6. Once a week it posts a report from the log, with LinkedIn statistics if enabled.

### Setup
1. Import and click Execute workflow. With `SHEET_ID` blank it plays a demo reply (`DEMO_REPLY`) with no credentials.
2. Use the same `config` as the drafting workflow.
3. Connect Google Sheets and Discord, and add a LinkedIn token with `w_organization_social` and your organisation URN.
4. Keep `TEST_RUN = true` until a full cycle ends at `STOP: not published`.

### Requirements
A LinkedIn company page with API access, the shared Google Sheet and the Discord approval channel. Slack is optional.

### Customization tips
Approval words, expiry, alert spacing and the report day are constants in `config`.

## 1. Find the open draft
Reads the log every 5 minutes. An expired draft is closed, never published. Most runs stop here.

## 2. Weekly report
Once a week, from the log: published, expired, cancelled and edited drafts, plus LinkedIn statistics if enabled.

## 3. Read the reply
Only a human's post, cancel or edit counts. Bots, chatter and replies already handled are ignored.

## 4. Check an edit
Same caption rules. A passing edit goes out again as a new draft; a failing one gets the reasons.

## 5. Verify and publish
Refuses a changed draft. Register, upload, publish. No retry on publish, so a timeout cannot double-post.

## 6. Alert on a rejected token
One alert in the channel per 6 hours. The approval stays open for after the fix.

## 7. Record the outcome
Marks the bank row and appends the log row with the post URN.

## 8. Report the run
Slack summary for anything worth knowing; idle polls stay quiet.

nodes.name: Every 5 minutes
nodes.notes: Polling, not a watcher process: nothing to keep alive across reboots. Most runs end at STOP: nothing awaiting.

nodes.name: find the pending draft
nodes.notes: An awaiting row is open until a later row with the same message id closes it.

nodes.name: what state is the draft in?
pull LinkedIn stats?
nodes.notes: STATS_ENABLED and a token, and at least one post this week. Needs r_organization_social.

nodes.name: [cred] LinkedIn - pull post stats
nodes.notes: organizationalEntityShareStatistics for this week's post URNs. A 403 means the app lacks Community Management API access; the report says so and goes out anyway.

nodes.name: demo channel?
nodes.notes: The demo log has a made-up draft, so its reply is read from a made-up channel (DEMO_REPLY in config).

nodes.name: [cred] Discord - read the channel
nodes.notes: Newest 50. The draft message is the anchor; if it has scrolled out, the gate waits rather than guessing.

nodes.name: read the approval reply
nodes.notes: THE GATE. After the draft only, never a bot, whole-message post/cancel, edit = first line, first decision wins.

nodes.name: check the edited caption
nodes.notes: Same caption rules as workflow 01. An edit never publishes: it becomes a new draft that needs its own post.

nodes.name: [cred] Discord - deliver the revised draft
nodes.notes: The revised caption with the original image. After import, confirm Files shows `data`.

nodes.name: the approved draft
nodes.notes: Publishes the caption from the DISCORD MESSAGE, fingerprint-checked against what was delivered.

nodes.name: publish it?
nodes.notes: False unless TEST_RUN is false and a token is set. The approval stays open either way.

nodes.name: [cred] LinkedIn - register the upload
nodes.notes: Step 1 of 3, publishes nothing. fullResponse + neverError so an expired token arrives as data and is alerted, not a red execution.

nodes.name: download the approved image
nodes.notes: The image the reviewer saw, fetched fresh from the approved message.

nodes.name: [cred] LinkedIn - upload the image
nodes.notes: Step 2 of 3. Raw bytes, not multipart. Still not public.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ author: $('config').first().json.linkedin_org_urn, commentary: $('the approved draft').first().json._caption_escaped, visibility: 'PUBLIC', distribution: { feedDistribution: 'MAIN_FEED', targetEntities: [], thirdPartyDistributionChannels: [] }, content: { media: { id: $('read the upload registration').first().json._image_urn } }, lifecycleState: 'PUBLISHED', isReshareDisabledByAuthor: false }) }}

nodes.name: [cred] LinkedIn - publish the post
nodes.notes: STEP 3 OF 3, IRREVERSIBLE. retryOnFail is OFF: a publish that timed out may have succeeded, and a retry double-posts.

nodes.name: alert due?
nodes.notes: At most one alert per ALERT_REPEAT_HOURS for the same draft, read from the log.

nodes.name: [cred] Sheets - mark the bank row
nodes.notes: Matches on 'Slug'. Rename that heading and change BANK_COLUMNS.slug AND this match field together.

nodes.name: STOP: demo - log row not written
worth reporting?
nodes.notes: Idle polls (nothing awaiting, still awaiting) are quiet: they would be 280 messages a day.
